facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident during transfer operations on CY-3210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on CY-3210 and PT-3210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. CY-3210 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 27 October 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on CY-3210 and PT-3210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
